panels.title: Write throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second FUSE clients push to data nodes (all selected clients, all tiers). Zero when nobody writes.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_put_chunk_bytes" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "write"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: PutChunk failures over range
panels.description: PutChunk failures seen by FUSE clients in the selected time range. Any value above zero means a data node refused or lost an upload; the client retries another target.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_put_chunk_failures" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "failures"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_stop"])
  |> sum()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: FUSE write op errors over range
panels.description: Failed FUSE write, create, flush, fsync, release and setattr calls in the selected range: errors the application sees. Should stay zero.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_errors" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^(write|create|flush|fsync|release|setattr)$/)
  |> spread()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "errors"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "_stop"])
  |> sum()
  |> duplicate(column: "_stop", as: "_time")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Commit rejects over range

panels.title: FUSE write latency (p50 vs p99)
panels.description: Latency of write(2) calls inside the FUSE client. Writes are buffered, so normal is microseconds; a p99 near the cap-wait time means writers are blocked at the dirty cap.

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_fuse_op_us" and (r._field == "p50" or r._field == "p99"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r.op =~ /^write$/)
    |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])

lo = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p50")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
hi = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p99")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [lo, hi])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

  |> group(columns: ["node", "op", "_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "p99" + " " + r.node + " " + r.op}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

panels.title: Data node put total latency (p50 vs p99)
panels.description: Whole-call PutChunk latency per data node (mean p50, max p99 over its disks). A p99 far above p50 means a few slow puts, typically one slow disk or a congested link.

targets.query:
base = from(bucket: "${bucket}")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "dtfs_data_put_total_us" and (r._field == "p50" or r._field == "p99"))
    |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.dc, set: ${dc:json}) and contains(value: r.role, set: ${role:json}) and contains(value: r.node, set: ${node:json}))
    |> group(columns: ["node", "_field"])

lo = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p50")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
hi = base
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "p99")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)

union(tables: [lo, hi])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: r._field + " " + r.node}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
